description:
Why Join Exadel

 We’re an AI-first global tech company with 25+ years of engineering leadership, 2,000+ team members, and 500+ active projects powering Fortune 500 clients, including HBO, Microsoft, Google, and Starbucks.

 From AI platforms to digital transformation, we partner with enterprise leaders to build what’s next.
What powers it all? Our people are ambitious, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

 About the Client

 A leading global digital banking platform and one of the largest neobanks in Latin America, headquartered in Brazil. The company provides a mobile-first suite of financial services—including credit cards, savings accounts, and investments—designed to eliminate bureaucracy and high fees. By leveraging advanced data analytics and a customer-centric digital infrastructure, the organization delivers transparent and accessible financial solutions to millions of users across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia.

 What You’ll Do

 
 Design, build, test, and maintain AI agent capabilities, including tools, skills, commands, and prompts

 Apply prompt-engineering techniques to improve agent accuracy, reliability, and usability

 Define structured output contracts, error-handling mechanisms, and evaluation methods for measuring agent behavior

 Develop extensions, plugins, and integrations for AI-powered development tools

 Build and maintain reusable application templates that establish consistent engineering standards across generated projects

 Develop developer-facing interfaces and internal tooling using React and TypeScript

 Improve the developer experience through actionable feedback, clear error messages, reliable defaults, and streamlined workflows

 Implement and maintain quality gates, including type checking, linting, automated testing, and build validation

 Apply containerization and runtime standards to support secure and consistent application development

 Collaborate with platform engineers to integrate AI capabilities with infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment workflows

 Monitor platform usage, identify friction points, and continuously improve the experience based on observed behavior and user feedback

 Document technical decisions, agent behavior, platform capabilities, and development workflows

 Incorporate AI agents into daily engineering activities and identify opportunities to improve their effectiveness

 
 What You Bring

 
 A solid foundation in application architecture, software engineering, and modern development practices

 Hands-on experience designing and implementing AI agents, including tools, skills, commands, and prompt engineering

 Experience evaluating AI agent behavior systematically using defined criteria, test cases, and supporting evidence

 Experience with React and TypeScript, including modern frontend development patterns and build tooling

 Experience building reusable application templates, developer tools, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities

 Knowledge of automated testing, type checking, linting, build validation, and software-quality practices

 Familiarity with containerization and application runtime environments

 Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, CI/CD concepts, and application deployment workflows

 Strong technical English skills, including written documentation and remote collaboration

 Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with excellent attention to detail

 Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and take ownership of technical outcomes

 Interest in incorporating AI agents into everyday engineering workflows and continuously improving their performance

 
 Nice to have

 
 Experience developing plugins, extensions, or integrations for AI-powered development environments

 Experience using Python for supporting services, automation, or AI-related workflows

 Familiarity with enterprise application security, governance requirements, and engineering guardrails

 Experience designing structured agent interfaces, typed outputs, and robust error-handling mechanisms

 Understanding of cloud-native architectures, CI/CD pipelines, and production deployment practices

 Experience improving developer productivity through internal platforms, reusable templates, or self-service tooling

 Exposure to AI evaluation frameworks, observability, or agent performance monitoring

 
 English level

 Upper-Intermediate

 Work Type: Remote

 Eligible Locations: São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

 Legal & Hiring Information

 
 Exadel is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to inclusion across minority, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, and more

 Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions

 Please note: this job description is not exhaustive. Duties and responsibilities may evolve based on business needs

 Compensation details are shared with candidates at the early stage of the recruitment process.

 The offer is not binding until a signed contract is in place.

 
 Your Benefits at Exadel

 Exadel benefits vary by location and contract type. Your recruiter will fill you in on the details.

 
 International projects

 In-office, hybrid, or remote flexibility

 Medical healthcare

 Recognition program

 Ongoing learning & reimbursement 

 Well-being program

 Team events & local benefits 

 Sports compensation 

 Referral bonuses 

 Top-tier equipment provision

 
 Exadel Culture

 We lead with trust, respect, and purpose. We believe in open dialogue, creative freedom, and mentorship that helps you grow, lead, and make a real difference. Ours is a culture where ideas are challenged, voices are heard, and your impact matters.
